The '''darkfly''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Fly/Legends|fly]]. A large number of darkflies lived inside the head of the decaying [[Sorcerers of Rhand|Sorcerer of Rhand]] [[Blessed Toxmalb]] and at Toxmalb's command, swarms of the flies would fly from his head and attempt to choke or suffocate his enemies.
